uncertainty: 95% percentile intervals from 1,000 deterministic week-cluster bootstrap replicates; omitted when fewer than two completed weeks exist.
inclusion: One immutable EXP-06 forecast per FotMob match ID and scheduled kickoff; prediction must precede scheduled kickoff; only actual finished scores are scored.
exclusions: No historical replay, no post-kickoff replacement, no stakes, no ROI/profit claim, and no readiness certification.
odds_comparison: Not available for this cohort: no bookmaker source and quote timestamp were captured.
